aggregation_semantics: distinct molecule records; count of molecules when counting rows
validation: molecule is the primary key of the molecule table; 343 rows, all matching TR followed by three digits.

semantic_filter: Each molecule record carries exactly one label value; no null labels were observed.
validation: SELECT label, COUNT(*) FROM molecule GROUP BY label returned '+':152 and '-':191 with no null group.

aggregation_semantics: count of atoms when counting rows
validation: atom_id is the primary key of the atom table; 12333 rows, all matching TR followed by three digits and an underscore.

semantic_filter: Each atom carries exactly one element code.
aggregation_semantics: grouping atoms by element; counting atoms of an element
validation: SELECT element, COUNT(*) FROM atom GROUP BY element returned 21 distinct lower-case symbol codes.

semantic_filter: Identifies the molecule that owns the atom.
validation: atom.molecule_id values share the TRnnn form of molecule.molecule_id; all 12333 atom rows carry one.

semantic_filter: Only the leading TRnnn segment of the atom identifier is a molecule reference; the remainder is the atom number.
validation: For every atom row the five-character prefix of atom_id equals the owning molecule_id; zero prefix mismatches were observed in the connected records.

semantic_filter: Only the numeric suffix after the molecule prefix is the atom number; it is not zero-padded, so the digit offset from the start of the identifier is not the atom position.
validation: atom_id lengths are 7, 8 or 9 characters; the character at offset 7 is always in the range 1-9, never 0.

aggregation_semantics: count of bonds when counting rows
validation: bond_id is the primary key of the bond table; 12379 rows.

semantic_filter: Each bond carries one bond type code; one bond row carries no code at all.
aggregation_semantics: grouping bonds by bond type; counting bonds of a type
validation: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type returned '-':10528, '=':1844, '#':6 and one null value on bond TR345_7_10.

semantic_filter: Identifies the molecule that owns the bond.
validation: bond.molecule_id values share the TRnnn form of molecule.molecule_id; every bond_id begins with its molecule_id.

semantic_filter: One row per directed atom end of a bond; each bond is stored twice, once from each participating atom.
aggregation_semantics: counting connections as rows of this table, or counting distinct bond references
grain: one row per atom end of a bond
validation: 24758 rows covering 12379 distinct bond references, each appearing exactly twice; counting a single atom column for atom TR009_12 returned 3 rows while adding the second atom column returned 6 rows for the same 3 bonds.

semantic_filter: The second atom end of the same bond; it is the reverse direction of the row stored under atom_id.
aggregation_semantics: same connection counted from the opposite atom end; must not be added to the first atom column without removing duplicates
grain: one row per atom end of a bond
validation: No row has atom_id equal to atom_id2, so the two directions are always distinct atoms.

semantic_filter: Identifies the bond that the connection row belongs to.
aggregation_semantics: counting distinct bonds touching a set of atoms
grain: one bond reference per connection row
validation: Every one of the 12379 bonds appears in the connection records, and the molecule prefix of the connection atoms always equals the molecule prefix of its bond.

semantic_filter: Atoms that appear in no connection record, in either atom position, participate in no bond.
aggregation_semantics: counting unbonded atoms; grouping them by element
validation: 49 atoms satisfy this condition; their elements are na, cl, h, zn and k.

semantic_filter: Atoms are attributed to their owning molecule before counting.
aggregation_semantics: count of atoms within each molecule group
validation: Atoms per molecule range from 4 to 174 with a mean of about 27.8.

semantic_filter: Numerator and denominator must be taken over the same bond set, for example the bonds of one molecule.
aggregation_semantics: count of bonds of the target type divided by the count of all bonds in the same set
validation: molecule TR008 has 26 bonds of which 1 is a double bond; molecule TR010 has 17 bonds of which 1 is a double bond.

semantic_filter: Numerator and denominator must be taken over the same atom set, such as the atoms of one molecule or of all molecules containing a given bond type.
aggregation_semantics: count of atoms of the target element divided by the count of all atoms in the same set
validation: 10972 atoms belong to molecules containing at least one double bond, of which 4246 are carbon.

semantic_filter: Requires grouping the bonds of the scope by bond type and comparing the group sizes.
aggregation_semantics: bond type with the largest bond count in the scope
validation: Single bonds dominate in the dataset as a whole and in sampled molecules such as TR008 and TR010.
